name: stream-rules
description: Watches the model's output and tool calls against your rules as they stream, and stops and corrects the model when one matches.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the mod on for new sessions. /stream-rules on|off overrides it for a session.

maxCorrections.title: Corrections per prompt
maxCorrections.description: Corrective turns allowed per prompt you send. Past it, a match on a reply becomes a reminder and the reply goes on.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Model that answers judged rules' yes/no questions.

judgeMaxPerTurn.title: Judged questions per turn
judgeMaxPerTurn.description: Judged questions asked after one turn, at most.

judgeAction.title: After a judged yes
judgeAction.description: remind adds the rule as a reminder; correct starts a corrective turn (counts toward the corrections cap).

toolRouting.title: Tool routing
toolRouting.description: Refuse Bash calls that read or edit files (cat, head, sed -i...) and point the model to Read or Edit. Off by default.
